attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012174769 (CC0): the grey basement and channelled ground storey, eared window architraves with hoods, the arched door, columns, balcony and double stoop with cast-iron railings, balustered aprons, the aedicule with its segmental pediment, medallions and crest, the relief friezes, rusticated quoins and the modillion cornice, the Molenpad side's blind axes and the yard gate with its lantern, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
